topic: Are existing link budget margins sufficient to handle SINR degradation from accumulated inter-beam interference in full frequency reuse scenarios?
response: Existing link budget margins are unlikely to be sufficient to handle SINR degradation from accumulated inter-beam interference in full frequency reuse scenarios. Inter-beam interference can significantly degrade the achievable carrier-to-interference plus noise power ratio (CINR), moving the link budget from a power-limited regime to an interference-limited regime.
reference_context: The reference context mentions that users located at the edges of beams suffer from severe co-channel interference in full frequency reuse scenarios, leading to a strong degradation of their achievable CINR. Additionally, it states that inter-beam interference has not been considered in previous power allocation methods.
